stages.command: install exact manifest clients; verify readiness, identity, auth, profiles and tools/list
honua admin connection create/test; import; publish/configure layer and access policy
honua_get_style; honua_apply_style_preset; honua_render_map; validate decoded PNG
discover/run geometry.buffer; wait/cancel canonical job; retain result
submit and poll durable AwaitingApproval proposal bound to item/version/hash
honua admin operate approveOperationProposal --profile approver --yes; poll published URL

notes: `clientCommands` names the terminal commands each stage needs from the pinned #136 clientArtifacts. A stage whose command is not shipped by the pinned bytes is blocked on honua-release#7 regardless of server readiness.

Command providers describe the expected package. The per-run integrity-verified commandSurface, including a successful `honua --help` probe for `admin`, determines presence; metadata cannot prove execution of credentialed or mutating verbs.

Stage evidence is keyed on the identities the server emits for a canonical invocation (honua-server OperationExecutionModels: operationInstanceId, correlationId, auditId, and proposalId for proposal/approval stages). A passing stage 3-8 must carry operationInstanceId/correlationId/auditId; stages 7-8 also proposalId. Approval is keyed on proposalId + resolvedBy + the approved replay's auditId.

`receiptOptional` fields (policyDecisionId, approvalId, actuatorId, verificationId) are kept as nullable receipt fields for compatibility with earlier receipts. No Honua candidate emits them, so they are never required and never invented; they are recorded only if a candidate actually returns one.
`blockedBy` lists the upstream contracts a stage waits on. It is contract metadata; the live driver derives the authoritative per-run blocker set from its own probes.
